lines: By command of the Crown, thou art to ride at once to the village of AAAB.
Deliver this letter to the village elder without delay. Ensure the village stands in good order and suffers no distress worthy of report.
Obtain a written reply from the elder and return immediately to my court. There is no time to linger — the affairs of the realm will not wait.
See this task done swiftly and faithfully. (King of the Kingdom)
